reason: The section is a brief case study illustrating how the 1999 Convention and UNSC resolutions 1373 and 1267 were applied to track and disrupt terrorist financing in the Madrid bombings. The case facts (units 1482-1483) serve as supporting context for the legal framework (units 1484-1486).
title_en: Case Study: The 1999 Convention and UNSC Resolutions in the Madrid Bombings
